name: border-beam
title: Border Beam
description: A glowing gradient segment travels around the rounded border of whatever container it is dropped into. Colour, width, speed and start delay are configurable.
use: A card needs to look active or loading without adding a spinner or changing its layout.
avoid: The beam is faint on light cards and needs a relative, rounded parent to clip it properly.
a11y: Decorative light with no reduced-motion check, and it relies on modern offset-path support. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three dark rounded cards sit on a black stage. Along their thin grey borders a short bright segment glows, amber-to-purple on one card and cyan-to-pink on another, each with a small text label and hex caption.
behaves: A small gradient light runs continuously around each border, looping every few seconds without stopping. The cards themselves stay still.
customise: Size, duration, borderWidth, anchor, colorFrom, colorTo and delay are props; the parent must be relative and rounded for the mask to fit.
weight: light: One pseudo-element running a CSS keyframe on offset-distance; no script.
